metadata.geometry_type: Verified_District_Point_Centroids_Only (No Polygon Boundary File in Workspace)
metadata.non_fabrication_notice: District boundary polygons are absent from the project workspace and are never invented. To attach official polygon boundaries in the future, pass a 36-district GeoJSON file to attach_optional_polygon_geojson().

properties.non_transmission_disclaimer: Spatial autocorrelation or hotspot significance indicates geographic clustering of reported surveillance counts; it does NOT prove cross-district pathogen transmission or causation.
